description: Paid ($0.05 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): diagnoses your x402 endpoint, then returns per problem the concrete change as code for your stack (express, next, hono, node, python, generic), filled in with your own payTo, amount, network and route. Same as GET /api/v1/fix. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_fix
title: Fix plan for an x402 endpoint ($0.05 via x402)
